title.zh: 将拉古纳省纳格卡兰的普托尔村更名为马来亚村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Putol in the Province of Nagcarlan, Province of Laguna, to Malaya
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Putol in the Province of Nagcarlan, Province of Laguna, to Malaya
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Putol tại Tỉnh Nagcarlan, Tỉnh Laguna thành Malaya
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Putol ในจังหวัด Nagcarlan, จังหวัด Laguna เป็น Malaya
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Putol di Provinsi Nagcarlan, Provinsi Laguna menjadi Malaya
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Putol di Wilayah Nagcarlan, Wilayah Laguna menjadi Malaya

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2100_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Putol in the Municipality of Nagcarlan, Province of Laguna, is changed to Malaya.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 28, 1959.
